newsitem.title: FINLAND: POLL - SILJA H1 LOSS SEEN NARROWING.
newsitem.headline: POLL - SILJA H1 LOSS SEEN NARROWING.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed an 86.5 million markka median
forecast for Finnish passenger ferry operator Silja Oy half-year
loss after financial items, before extraordinary items and tax:
Loss before extras, tax
(FIM million)
Median 86.5
Mean 85.0
Lowest 126.0
Highest 53.8
(Forecasts by eight analysts)
Silja's results are due on August 15 at 0900/0600 GMT.
In January-June 1996, Silja had a 127 million markka loss
after financial items, and its full-year 1996 loss was 133
million markka after financial items.
In the first quarter this year, Silja's loss narrowed to 106
million markka from 128 million a year earlier.
In April, Silja repeated it expected to reach a break-even
result or higher for the full financial year 1997.
Seven analysts gave forecasts for the full-year 1997, and
the median was for a 33 million markka profit (mean 42 million).
Estimates ranged from a 27 million markka loss to a 143 million
markka profit.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank,
Aros Securities, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, Handelsbanken,
Merita Securities and Opstock.
